title: Towards a Robust Expert Finding in Community Question Answering Platforms
reasoning: The paper focuses on a topic-oriented user-interaction model for expert finding in Community Question Answering (CQA) platforms. While the abstract mentions 'fair expert finding' and 'transparency', the evaluation is based purely on technical ranking metrics (MRR, P@1, NDCG). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
